text_block_list.text: It happened when I was passing near the fields—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Mmm,
you have a wonderful, healthy glow!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Graceful! The tension on your surface is marvelous.
It shows just how well-nurtured you are!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Mm?! What a coincidence!
Well met, welcome, Trainer!”
choice_data_list: Um, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain! I was simply praising
the honorable carrots gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving! I wish to provide the Umamusume with a wonderful environment.
In other words, high-quality carrots are essential!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Carrots that are highly nutritious and delicious—
in other words, carrots grown with love!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fact! If praised with love,
carrots grow splendidly. Just like Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Love is respect and resolve!
Knowing the true essence of your subject, and treating it with reverence."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To see things through to the very end, no matter what happens.
To praise them, nurture them, and bring out their utmost potential.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "That is what love is! In other words—"

Just as Chairwoman Akikawa crouched down
and pulled out a single carrot—
(Crunch!!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Like this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious! This flavor is true proof of growth.
Taking the responsibility to raise it was well worth it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving! I truly hope the Umamusume will
one day mature just like these fine carrots!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes.
Until the day comes... that everyone reaches maturity!

Chairwoman Akikawa speaks with passionate fervor.
Though I can't quite grasp what she's getting at...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Grow even more, everyone!
Grow strong and sturdy enough to reach the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So that you may one day become fine nourishment for our Umamusume!
Now is the time to grow, my fellow carrots!

You could feel that in her own way, she was
facing the Umamusume with utmost sincerity.

What is more, I believe there is something respectable
in her ambition. In that case—
choice_data_list: Shall I help with the fieldwork?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing!
Truly a bolt from the blue...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Request!
If you don't mind, I would love your help!
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll go till the field.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much appreciated! For the sake of both the Umamusume
and the carrots, give it your absolute all!

Just as I raised the hoe to plow the field――
at that very moment――
(Crack!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: How ominous! What was that sound just now?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Frozen stiff! That facial expression, that cold sweat!
Don't tell me... did your lower back give out!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Assemble! Everyone, we have an emergency patient!
Come forth, come forthhh!!
It seems she didn't have enough strength to swing the hoe...

After that, academy staff rushed over
and carried me away on a stretcher...

The back pain took its toll,
affecting <chrname>'s training as well...
